title: Royal Danish Library (KB) National Elsevier Agreement 2025–2028
institution: Royal Danish Library (KB) / National Licensing Consortium
notes: Denmark's national research-library consortium (Royal Danish Library / KB) multi-year Elsevier agreement, running 2025–2028. Individually confirmed active Scopus/SciVal/Pure subscriptions at all 8 tracked Danish universities (KU, AU, DTU, SDU, AAU, CBS, RUC, ITU) under related institutional agreements — see Competitor Matrix. Exact contract value and per-product breakdown not publicly disclosed. Web of Science (Clarivate) also remains active on KB's 2026 national agreement list — Denmark has not seen the WoS-cancellation wave affecting Netherlands/Finland/France universities.
